definitions.quarter_scope: Five segment rows. proforma_q42016 is on the disclosed pro forma perimeter and calendar. extra_week2015 is the prior extra-week sales amount. change and growth compare reconstructed Q4 2016 with the matched-duration Q4 2015. Segment keys are ahold_usa, delhaize_america, netherlands, belgium and cse.
definitions.comparable_periods: Fifteen rows, the five segments for each period fy, q4 and pre_q4. FY and Q4 use the matched-duration comparison. pre_q4 means the respective annual reporting period before the source Q4, not nine calendar months. Growth uses prior sales as denominator. No uniform weekly sales assumption is authorized.
definitions.annual_change_bridge: One row. statutory_change is annual IFRS 2016 less 2015. presentation_change is the current-minus-prior change in pro forma less IFRS sales. prior_extra_week is the positive prior-year extra-week amount. comparable_change is the group matched-duration annual change using independently reported group totals. comparable_growth uses the matched-duration group prior-year denominator. segment_residual is summed segment matched-duration annual changes less the group comparable change. Keep separately reported totals independent.

claim_assertions.claim_1: Every supplied segment has positive pre-Q4 sales growth on the requested basis.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The requested matched-duration annual sales increase equals the annual statutory IFRS sales increase.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Volume growth alone caused the entire matched-duration pro forma annual sales increase.

numeric_policy: Displayed-value arithmetic. Absolute tolerances are computational, not claims of source precision.
